panel.introduction: 103P/Hartley 2 is the elongated, two-lobed comet visited by EPOXI in 2010. In Source constraints, solid gray marks stereo control and blue marks limb silhouettes. The gray grid identifies poorly constrained regions in both views.

facts.label: Stereo coverage
facts.value: 244 stereo control points on about half the nucleus

moreFacts.label: Presentation
moreFacts.value: Published PDS shape model, including poorly constrained source estimates. Both views use the gray grid for source-flagged poorly constrained regions. Source constraints keeps solid gray for stereo control and blue for limb silhouettes. Grid regions lack those constraints; they are not necessarily wholly unobserved. These are evidence categories, not surface colors. The cartographic north direction follows the long axis at the 2010 encounter, not a spin pole. Hartley 2 tumbles; this display holds an arbitrary rotational phase and does not simulate that motion.

controls.label: Shape model
controls.description: Complete published PDS shape, simplified for display. The gray grid identifies source-flagged poorly constrained regions; solid gray covers stereo-controlled and limb-constrained regions. These are model materials, not observed albedo. Source constraints distinguishes the two better-constrained categories.
